cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. They've added a fourth inspection to our climbing wall. Wonderful. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. A whole month without an uninspected climb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the safest season we've ever offered.

mechanism: A manages delays to a climbing-wall opening, takes cancellation work and presents the lost season as added safety.
confusable: Unlike simple cheerfulness about bad news, A treats every new inspection restriction as evidence the protective system is improving.
comparison: A season closure and customer calls differ from independent signatures on school forms.
seedUse: D188-a fourth inspection and lost season; S02-a absorbs administrative work to keep B with the safety account.
